summary_en: Nomura Kogei updates its progress and initiatives on management with awareness of cost of capital and share price. Specific targets and metrics are disclosed in the attached material.
title_en: Updates on Initiatives to Realize Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief: Nomura Kogei announced an update to its initiatives regarding management with awareness of cost of capital and share price. The company provided progress updates and disclosed details of its ongoing efforts in an attached material. Specific targets, metrics, and implementation timelines are contained in the supplementary document referenced in this announcement.
